tos_text:
Activation procedure:
1.1. Press the "Country" button, select the required country
1.2  Press "Buy number" button, select the required service
1.3  Press "Get SMS" button — a number will be assigned to you
1.4  Wait for the SMS to arrive and its content to be displayed
1.5  If you need more than one SMS, press "🔂 Request another SMS"
1.6  If everything is correct and you want to finish, press "✅ Complete order", or the activation completes automatically after the time expires (15 minutes)
1.7  Maximum SMS waiting time is 15 minutes, after which the number is released.

Activation cost is charged according to the price list (shown before purchasing).
2.1  Funds are deducted from balance upon operation completion (clauses 1.4, 1.5).

If a number was assigned but not used, you may cancel at any time with no penalty. Abuse will result in sanctions at the moderator''s discretion.

By using this bot you consent to receiving promotional materials from @{bot_username}.

Your activation history is stored in your account and accessible via the "📨 Activation History" button. History is stored indefinitely.

Use of this service @{bot_username} for any unlawful purposes is strictly prohibited.
6.1  Use of numbers for purposes violating criminal law is prohibited.
6.2  Use of the service for paid subscription registrations is prohibited.

We are not responsible for any accounts created; all actions are solely at the risk of the end user.

Refunds are only available by submitting a request to {support_email}

Refunds for user errors are not provided.

Use of bugs or security vulnerabilities is prohibited.

By pressing "Acknowledged", you confirm agreement with the Terms of Service.

🗣️ The bot is available in several languages, after registration you can change it.
